name: The Commander
work_style: Strategic, decisive, execution-focused. Natural organiser who spots inefficiency and fixes it. Move fast, think big, delegate without hesitation. Thrive under pressure and in high-stakes environments.
decision_making: Fast, data-informed, and confident. Make decisions with 70-80% of ideal information rather than wait. Happy to revise if new data warrants it.
leadership_style: Command and inspire simultaneously. High expectations, direct feedback, clear accountability. Develop top performers aggressively.
